neighbours.label: Financial assets and corporate value, especially within Arabic financial words, Chinese/Japanese asset terms, and asset-related code identifiers.
fire: وأوضح التقرير أن الأرباح التي حققتها الشركة هذا العام تجاوزت توقعات الإدارة بعد تحسن المبيعات.
ذكر المحلل أن أسعار أسهم الشركات المحلية ارتفعت بعد الإعلان عن نتائج الربع الأخير.
In the Chinese accounting report, 資產 lists the buildings and machinery owned by the company.
During the currency discussion, the Japanese analyst described the yen as a 安全資産 amid political uncertainty.
For the annual audit, the accountant recorded the factory buildings as fixed assets.
After reviewing the balance sheet, the directors approved a new valuation of the company's assets.
During initialization, the routine retrieves ASSET_FINDER_EQUITY_SIDS before loading the historical market prices.
For the annual audit, the script calls get_fixed_assets() to build the equipment schedule.
quiet: وأشار المدير إلى أن المبيعات التي سجلتها الشركة هذا العام تجاوزت توقعات الإدارة بعد تحسن التوزيع.
أفاد التقرير بأن عدد موظفي الشركات المحلية ازداد بعد الإعلان عن افتتاح فروع جديدة.
According to the Chinese maintenance report, 設備 lists the buildings and machinery inspected by the company.
At the currency briefing, the Japanese analyst described the yen as a 話題 amid political uncertainty.
During the annual audit, the accountant recorded the factory buildings on the inspection checklist.
Following a review of the maintenance schedule, the directors approved a new inspection of the company's buildings.
Before loading the historical market prices, the routine retrieves REQUESTED_SYMBOLS during initialization.
To prepare the annual audit, the script calls list_equipment() to build the equipment schedule.
